Edit the Ferryx landing page at /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/site to remove all fabricated numeric claims and move the Shortcuts section out (it is being replaced by a separate Astro docs site).

Context: Benchmarks section (site/src/components/Benchmarks.tsx) contains fabricated measurements (115 ms, 82 MB, 18.4 MB, <0.4 ms and Electron comparisons) with NO evidence in the repo — they must go. Shortcuts.tsx content moves to docs (another agent handles that); remove it here.

MUST-DO steps:
1. site/src/components/Benchmarks.tsx: DELETE the entire `metrics` array and its cards grid (the four numeric metric cards). KEEP the qualitative feature matrix table but REMOVE these two numeric rows from comparisonRows: "Sub-150ms Cold Launch" and "Memory Consumption Under 100MB". Retitle the section: heading → "Built Different", subtitle → "How Ferryx's architecture compares to traditional Electron-based AI IDEs and terminal emulators." Change section id to "architecture" so it serves as the architecture anchor. Remove now-unused lucide-react imports if any become unused.
2. site/src/components/Navbar.tsx: change nav items — remove the "Shortcuts" link entirely; repoint the "Architecture" link href to "#architecture" (it currently points there already — verify); add a new nav item "Docs" BEFORE Architecture pointing to DOCS_URL. Define `const DOCS_URL = "http://localhost:4321"` near the top of Navbar.tsx with comment `// Separate Astro docs site (docs/), dev server port 4321`.
3. Remove the Shortcuts section: delete site/src/components/Shortcuts.tsx and remove its import + usage wherever rendered (grep for `Shortcuts` across site/src — likely App.tsx or Landing page file).
4. Sweep ALL other landing files (Hero.tsx, Features.tsx, CTA.tsx, Footer.tsx, App files) for remaining numeric marketing claims and remove/reword them without numbers. Known offenders in Features.tsx: "sub-millisecond I/O latency" and "Instant startup in under 150ms" — reword to drop the numbers (e.g. "Direct OS-level pseudoterminal allocation with minimal I/O latency", "Instant startup"). Do not touch version strings like v1.0-alpha.
5. Verify: grep -rn "ms\b\|MB\|115\|840\|220\|0\.4\|150" over site/src/components must show no leftover marketing numbers; then run `bun run --cwd /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/site build` — must exit 0.

FORBIDDEN: do not touch site/src/mock/**, do not add new sections, do not alter LiveFerryxDemo.tsx logic.
SUCCESS: no numeric claims remain on the landing page, Shortcuts component gone, Docs nav link present, site build exits 0.
